name: Nadia Argento
original_name: นาเดีย อาร์จีนโต้
source:
Etymology: Nadia = Hope | Argento = Silver
Age: 16
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 11 Student / Ava's Right Hand
Personality: Cheerful and chatty, she reads Ava perfectly due to their close bond. Nadia is the spark that keeps conversations alive, but when duty calls, she transforms into a serious workaholic.

[From in-game profile]
